def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    groups=[]
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if active[i]:
            j=i
            while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
            groups.append((i,j))
            i=j
        else: i+=1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(groups)<2: return out
    (a0,a1),(b0,b1)=groups[:2]
    if a1-a0 != b1-b0: return out
    ha=a1-a0
    A=[[grid[a0+r][c]!=bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(ha)]
    B=[[grid[b0+r][c]!=bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(ha)]
    best=None
    for dx in range(-w+1,w):
        ov=sum(A[r][c] and 0<=c+dx<w and B[r][c+dx] for r in range(ha) for c in range(w))
        if best is None or ov>best[0]: best=(ov,dx)
    dx=best[1]
    ca=sum(map(sum,A)); cb=sum(map(sum,B))
    if ca>=cb: # A source, B target
        for r in range(ha):
            for c in range(w):
                tc=c+dx
                if A[r][c] and 0<=tc<w and not B[r][tc]: out[b0+r][tc]=1
    else: # B source, A target; B col = A col + dx
        for r in range(ha):
            for c in range(w):
                tc=c-dx
                if B[r][c] and 0<=tc<w and not A[r][tc]: out[a0+r][tc]=1
    return out

for name,dd in [('demo1',d1),('demo2',d2)]:
    o=transform(dd)
    print(name,[(r,c) for r in range(len(dd)) for c in range(len(dd[0])) if o[r][c]==1])

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    active = [any(v != bg for v in row) for row in grid]
    groups=[]
    i=0
    while i<h:
        if active[i]:
            j=i
            while j<h and active[j]: j+=1
            groups.append((i,j)); i=j
        else: i+=1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(groups)<2: return out
    (a0,a1),(b0,b1)=groups[:2]
    if a1-a0 != b1-b0: return out
    n=a1-a0
    A=[[grid[a0+r][c]!=bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    B=[[grid[b0+r][c]!=bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]
    dx=max(range(-w+1,w), key=lambda d:sum(A[r][c] and 0<=c+d<w and B[r][c+d] for r in range(n) for c in range(w)))
    maxA=max((c for row in A for c,v in enumerate(row) if v), default=-1)
    maxB=max((c for row in B for c,v in enumerate(row) if v), default=-1)
    if maxA>maxB: # copy A to B, shifted by dx
        for r in range(n):
            for c in range(w):
                tc=c+dx
                if A[r][c] and 0<=tc<w and not B[r][tc]: out[b0+r][tc]=1
    else: # copy B to A
        for r in range(n):
            for c in range(w):
                tc=c-dx
                if B[r][c] and 0<=tc<w and not A[r][tc]: out[a0+r][tc]=1
    return out

    o=transform(dd)
    print(name,[(r,c) for r in range(len(dd)) for c in range(len(dd[0])) if o[r][c]==1])
